full_prompt_en: This is a square surreal mixed-media portrait of an elderly white-bearded figure in a dark formal uniform against a collage of stone, spirals, and a red disk. The figure fills the center from chest upward. A tall black peaked cap with a small pale emblem casts shadow over the forehead; the face remains pale and stern, with a large white mustache and beard. One eye area carries a small sharp red accent that links the face to the broad vermilion circle behind the right side of the head. The uniform has a high collar and a vertical row of buttons, its near-black mass anchoring the lower middle. Behind and beside the figure, grayscale rocklike fragments collide with concentric striped circles and tightly curved bands. A large dark spiral occupies the lower left, while another pale striped arc presses in from the right. Near the bottom, a few tiny human silhouettes stand among rough debris, making the central figure seem enormous by comparison. Thin yellow, blue, red, and black parallel lines twist in the upper left, supplying a small burst of color beside the dominant red disk. Light on the face resembles flat archival photographic illumination, while the collage shapes carry their own graphic shadows and printed texture. Abraded paper edges, grain, and mismatched scales make the surface intentionally constructed rather than a single realistic location. No lettering is readable. The overall composition is unsettling and ceremonial, contrasting one still, rigid portrait with spinning optical forms and a stark red backdrop.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形超现实混合媒介肖像，一名白须年长人物穿深色正式制服，背景拼贴着石头、螺旋和红色圆盘。人物从胸部以上填满中央。高大的黑色檐帽带小浅色徽饰，在额头投下阴影；面部浅白而严肃，留着大块白色胡子和八字须。一侧眼部有尖锐的小红色强调，将面孔与头部右后方宽阔的朱红圆盘联系起来。制服有高领和竖向纽扣，近黑体量固定下方中央。人物身后和两侧，灰阶岩石般碎片与同心条纹圆、紧密弯曲色带相撞。大型深色螺旋占据左下，另一道浅色条纹弧从右侧挤入。底部附近，几道微小人形剪影站在粗糙碎石之间，使中央人物相比之下显得巨大。细黄、蓝、红、黑平行线在左上扭转，在主导性的红圆旁提供小块色彩爆发。脸上的光类似平坦的档案照片照明，拼贴形状则带有各自的图形阴影和印刷肌理。磨损的纸边、颗粒与错配的尺度使表面明显是有意构造，而非单一写实地点。没有可读文字。整体构图令人不安而带仪式感，以一道静止、僵直的肖像对比旋转光学形态和鲜明红色背景。
style_prompt_en: The mixed-media treatment collides archival grayscale modeling with a few saturated red and multicolor graphic accents. Large flat disks, concentric rings, and tight parallel curves interrupt rough photographic textures. One rigid central mass anchors the frame while spiraling peripheral shapes imply motion and unstable scale. Hard printed edges sit beside torn-looking stone and grainy paper passages. Light on the focal surface is relatively flat, but the darker lower area and pale face retain strong value separation. Small scattered marks add narrative scale without filling the open zones. The overall effect is ceremonial, disorienting, and tactile, with disparate materials unified by black, cream, and vermilion.
style_prompt_zh: 这种混合媒介处理让档案般的灰阶塑形与少量饱和红、多色图形强调相撞。大型平面圆盘、同心环与紧密平行曲线打断粗糙摄影肌理。一块僵直中央体量固定画框，外围螺旋形状则暗示运动与不稳定尺度。硬朗印刷边缘与像撕裂石面、颗粒纸张的部分并置。焦点表面的光相对平坦，但较暗下部和浅色中央仍有强明度分离。小小散落标记提供叙事尺度，却不填满开阔区域。整体效果带仪式感、令人迷失且有触感，不同材料由黑、奶油色与朱红统一。
theme_en: An elderly uniformed figure against a surreal collage of red disk and optical spirals
theme_zh: 一位年长制服人物立于红色圆盘与光学螺旋的超现实拼贴前
name: Alejandro Jodorowsky
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
